name: [FREE WEEKEND] Ignited's Sandbox: Early Access
desc:
We've officially released free to play PERMANENTLY! Use code "RELEASE" and "1MILLION" for free starter cash!

Ignited's Sandbox, the testing grounds for all things Ignited Softworks and beyond. This is NOT a traditional sandbox game, but rather a place for testing our core custom frameworks, while incorporating game elements and progression.

This game currently features:
🔫 Immersive combat system, with a variety of weapons!
🏙️ Detailed and dynamic environments, that react to what you do!
⚔️ Adrenaline-filled PvP arenas, where you can versus your friends and foes!
👀 And frequent updates with a lot more to come, so keep an eye out!

⭐ Like the game and join the group for PERMANENT 25% cash and experience boost!
